hints.title: Permutation with Pairwise Constraint
hints.text: Build permutations one element at a time. Each newly placed integer must sum with the preceding integer to yield an exact square number.

hints.title: Sorting and Duplicate Pruning
hints.text: Sort the numbers beforehand. When multiple identical values exist at the current recursion level, only process the first unused one to avoid counting duplicate permutations.

hints.title: Backtracking Search
hints.text: Maintain an array of visited flags and the previous value. If count reaches array length, increment answer by 1. For each candidate, check if last is null or last + current is a perfect square.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of elements in array (N <= 12)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all permutations blindly checks N! candidates without pruning invalid prefixes early.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pruning invalid branch sums and skipping duplicate elements reduces the search space dramatically.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle duplicate permutation avoidance and test perfect squares efficiently.
complexity.notes: Since N <= 12, backtracking with tight pruning easily completes well within the time limit.
